hook: Telangana's final voter list now comes on *Dec 22*, not Nov 30
hook_b: Telangana's final voter list now comes on *Dec 22*, not Nov 30
tldr: The Election Commission extended the Special Intensive Revision schedule in seven states including Telangana; claims and objections now close December 15.

beats.what: The deadline for claims and objections moved from November 26 to December 15, and the final roll from November 30 to December 22.
beats.why: ECI also revised the schedule for ASDD electors who were dropped from draft rolls for not submitting enumeration forms.
beats.care: ASDD enumeration forms are being distributed and collected from November 18 to 30, and must be disposed of by December 10.

causes.label: ECI revises SIR schedule in 7 states

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 17): ECI wrote to Telangana CEO C Sudharsan Reddy with the revised dates.

cards.q: Have you checked your name on the draft voter list?

qs: How will ASDD voters learn that their names were dropped?
What happens to the 76,058 names still pending?

facts.t: ECI flagged discrepancies or no 2002 mapping for *92,88,188* voters who filed forms.
So far *57,644* electors have been found ineligible.

viz.verdict: More time for claims, later final list
About 1 in 5 voters landed in the ASDD list

watch: How many of the 76,058 pending names are decided before December 15.
